dedupe_keys.name: panasonic 18650pf battery state of charge test data

description: Kollmeyer publishes controlled tests of a new 2.9 Ah Panasonic 18650PF lithium-ion cell for battery-model and state-of-charge estimation benchmarks. The University of Wisconsin-Madison experiments include hybrid pulse-power characterisation, drive cycles and impedance spectroscopy at five temperatures, using a thermal chamber and Digatron tester. The charge procedure uses 1C to 4.2 V with a 50 mA cutoff and battery temperature at least 12 degrees Celsius. Coverage is one laboratory cell, with no stated acquisition dates, sampling interval or file encoding on the landing page. Version 1 was published on 21 June 2018 and is free under CC BY 4.0 through Mendeley. A limitation is that single-cell tests do not establish pack variability or field ageing distributions; detailed temperature values require the separate README. Simulation uses include calibrating voltage and state-of-charge models for storage and electric vehicles. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with a specified commercial-cell benchmark. No traces or estimator were run.
